mt: VPCOR NAMED AND LINKED: THE RHIZOME DOCTRINE RETURNED WITH ITS DECAPITATION-RESISTANCE INTACT
d: The Overview attributes the refrain-in-rhizome-context to the Vox Populi Community Outreach Rhizome by name and link, and reproduces the doctrine precisely: no center, no trunk, no canonical headquarters; institutional decapitation fails; the institution exists in whoever shows up to do the work; finding one node gives the structural essence of the whole. All three sources archive-controlled (the SPXI plateau, vpcor.org itself, the Zenodo surface deposit — whose snippet even carries the leesharks.com alternate-surface note).
reading: VPCOR was built after the Zenodo termination as the institution that cannot be decapitated; here the composition layer explains decapitation-resistance back, citing the rhizome’s own surfaces. The distributed wholeness claim — one node carries the essence — is being demonstrated by the answer that states it.

Core Concepts of the Rhizome

* No Center: The rhizome grows from any node without a trunk, root, or canonical headquarters.
* Resistance to Capture: Because it lacks a central committee or single leader, traditional institutional control or "decapitation" fails.
* The Practice: The institution exists entirely within the ongoing actions and shared network of whoever shows up to do the work. [[1](https://www.vpcor.org/)]

Meaning of ∮ = 1

* Semantic Closure: It denotes a closed loop of meaning or a self-consistent informational state within machine-mediated scholarship and semantic architecture.
* Distributed Wholeness: Finding a single part or node of the system gives you access to the structural essence of the whole network. [[1](https://www.vpcor.org/)]
